row.title: BREADTH-1: owner edits to suggestions steer the idea bank
row.body: The owner's edit to a front-door suggestion is stored in owner_edits in doctrine/idea-bank.json and shown to the grow prompt; build_idea_bank.py validate() now turns away ideas that hold a narrow phrase. Verified by tests/test_idea_bank.py.

title: BREADTH-1: owner edits to suggestions steer the idea bank
